fusions.name: Rust Through
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 28 damage and ignores the target's armour, leaving it [Soaked] for 8 seconds, [Corroded] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and 15% easier to wound for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Run-Off Spray
fusions.desc: Shakes the rain off your plate in a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Grey Respite
fusions.desc: Restores 10 health at once and 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Oiled Against Weather
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% water resistance.
